title: Compare
description: `hpr compare`, as JSON: a log against a simulation of it, each residual logged less simulated.

clock_bound_s.description: How well the two clocks are lined up, s.

height_m.description: The log's samples less the simulated height, m above the pad.

height_read_as.description: What the log's height stands for, and so how the simulation's is read.

kind.description: What kind of result this is: a measurement set against a model.

log_liftoff_s.description: The log's liftoff, s on its own clock.

logger.description: The logger, as the log names it.

method.description: How the clocks were lined up: `shared liftoff`.

reaches_landing.description: Whether the residuals run to a landing read from the log, not just to the log's end.

simulated_liftoff_s.description: The simulated liftoff, as the same reader finds it, s after ignition.

speed_m_s.description: The smoother's vertical speed less the simulated, m/s, up; or why it is withheld.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

trust.description: The trust note the text form ends with.

end_s.description: When it ends, s after the log's liftoff.

largest.description: The residual of largest size, with its sign.

largest_at_s.description: When that residual falls, s after the log's liftoff.

mean.description: The mean residual, with its sign.

start_s.description: When it starts, s after the log's liftoff.

logged_sd.description: The log's standard error on it; null for a raw sample, which states none.

simulated.description: The simulation's value, read as the log's sensor would read it.

time_after_liftoff_s.description: When it falls, s after the log's liftoff.

CompareResiduals.description: One quantity's residuals, from liftoff to the log's landing or its end.

past_simulation.description: The log's samples after the simulated flight had ended: compared with nothing.

logged.description: The log's, with its bound, 90% interval, source and provenance.

logged_minus_simulated.description: Logged less simulated; null if either is withheld or is a floor.

simulated.description:
The same reader's reading of the simulated flight: no source or provenance, as it wasn't
measured.

CompareSpeed.description: The speed's residuals, which need the smoother.

oneOf.description: The smoother's speed less the simulated.
Why the smoother gives no speed.

detail.description: The reason in words, with the log's own numbers.

HeightReadAs.description: What a log's height stands for.

oneOf.description: A barometer's reading: the standard atmosphere's altitude of the pressure, less the pad's.
A height climbed: a GNSS receiver's, or the accelerometer's integral.

Kind.description: What kind of result a command printed: the kind every figure in it is.

oneOf.description: From a model of the flight, not measured.
Measured: an altimeter's log, or a weather balloon's sounding.
A weather model's forecast.
A reanalysis: a weather model's fit to past observations, such as ERA5.
Copied from a data file, such as a motor's curve file, or computed from it.
A measurement set against a model: a log against a simulation of it.

ReadingInterval.description:
A reading's 90% interval: on the synthetic flights, the truth lay below `low` about 5% of the
time and above `high` about 5% (`hpr_flightdata::readings::interval`).

high.description: Its upper end, in the reading's unit.

low.description: Its lower end, in the reading's unit.

ReadingProvenance.description: Whether a reading was measured on the track, derived from it, or clipped by it.

oneOf.description: A time or height read off the filtered track.
Worked out from the track, such as a speed from its slope.
Measured, but at the sensor's range, so the true value may lie beyond it.
A provenance this build of `hpr` doesn't name.

ReadingSource.description: The height track a reading came from.

oneOf.description: The logger's own barometric altitude, the record's primary track.
A pressure channel, turned into a height by the 1976 standard atmosphere.
A barometric altitude kept in a channel, above the pad or above sea level.
A GNSS receiver's altitude: no reading is taken from it.
The accelerometer along the rocket's axis.
A source this build of `hpr` doesn't name.

ResidualPhase.description: A part of the flight, on the log's readings.

oneOf.description: Liftoff to the log's burnout.
The log's burnout to its apogee.
Liftoff to the log's apogee, where its burnout isn't read.
The log's apogee to its landing, or its end.
The whole log after liftoff, where its apogee isn't read whole.

TimelineCell.description: One log's cell in a row.

oneOf.description: What the log read.

bound.description: The bound on its error; null where the reading states none.

interval.description: Its 90% interval; null where the log's own section holds it.

is_floor.description: Whether the true value may lie any amount above it.

provenance.description: Measured, derived or clipped; null for the smoother's fused apogee.

source.description: The track it came from; null for the smoother's fused apogee.

oneOf.description: Why it read nothing.

detail.description: The reason in words, with the log's own numbers.

TimelineWhat.description:
A reading on a timeline. Heights are m above each log's own pad, speeds m/s, accelerations
m/s², times s after each log's liftoff.

oneOf.description: Apogee's height.
Apogee's time.
The smoother's apogee height.
The top vertical speed.
The top acceleration.
Burnout.
The flight time, liftoff to landing.
The rate of descent under the drogue.
The main's opening's height.
The rate of descent under the main.
